import hashlib, json, os, re, shlex, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path

WORKTREE = Path("/workspace/android-studio-module-presentation")
ARTIFACTS = Path("/workspace/android-studio-artifacts/module-presentation-task")
sha256 = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def excluded(path):
    parts = Path(path).parts
    if parts[:2] != ("docs", "android-studio"):
        return False
    if len(parts) == 3 and (parts[2].endswith(".md") or parts[2] in ("reference-manifest.json", "test-parity.json")):
        return True
    if len(parts) == 4 and parts[2] == "ports" and parts[3].endswith(".json"):
        return True
    return len(parts) >= 4 and parts[2] == "evidence" and Path(path).suffix in (".json", ".log")

def snapshot():
    names = subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-files", "-z", "--cached", "--others", "--exclude-standard"], cwd=WORKTREE).decode().split("\0")
    hashes = {name: sha256(WORKTREE / name) for name in sorted(set(names)) if name and not excluded(name)}
    return {"hashes": hashes, "index": subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-files", "--stage", "-z"], cwd=WORKTREE).hex(), "status": subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z"], cwd=WORKTREE).hex()}

baseline = snapshot()
(ARTIFACTS / "whole-product-source-before.json").write_text(json.dumps(baseline, indent=2) + "\n")
roots = [WORKTREE / "crates/android_tools/src/android_tools.rs"] + sorted((WORKTREE / "crates/android_tools/tests").glob("*.rs"))
mtime_receipt = []
for path in roots:
    before_hash = sha256(path)
    before_mtime = path.stat().st_mtime_ns
    os.utime(path, None)
    assert sha256(path) == before_hash
    mtime_receipt.append({"path": str(path), "sha256": before_hash, "before_mtime_ns": before_mtime, "after_mtime_ns": path.stat().st_mtime_ns})
(ARTIFACTS / "current-worktree-compiler-freshness.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reason": "Shared relative dependency paths require fresh current-worktree roots; source bytes and Git state remain unchanged.", "roots": mtime_receipt}, indent=2) + "\n")
assert snapshot() == baseline
commands = [
    ("all-features-tests", ["cargo", "test", "--locked", "-p", "android_tools", "--all-features", "--message-format=json"]),
    ("library-build", ["cargo", "build", "--locked", "-p", "android_tools", "--all-features", "--message-format=json"]),
    ("strict-clippy", ["./script/clippy", "--locked", "-p", "android_tools"]),
    ("format-check", ["cargo", "fmt", "--all", "--", "--check"]),
]
results = []
for name, command in commands:
    before = snapshot()
    started = time.monotonic()
    shell = "source /workspace/cloud-environment/env.sh\n" + shlex.join(command)
    log = ARTIFACTS / (name + ".log")
    with log.open("wb") as output:
        run = subprocess.run(["bash", "-lc", shell], cwd=WORKTREE, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
    after = snapshot()
    record = {"command": command, "exit_code": run.returncode, "elapsed_seconds": elapsed, "log": str(log), "log_sha256": sha256(log), "source_bindings": len(after["hashes"]), "whole_source_git_index_status_unchanged": before == after == baseline}
    (ARTIFACTS / (name + ".json")).write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
    results.append(record)
    print(json.dumps({"check": name, **record}), flush=True)
    assert before == after == baseline, name + " changed source/Git state"
    if run.returncode:
        raise SystemExit(run.returncode)
    if name == "all-features-tests":
        text = log.read_text()
        summaries = re.findall(r"test result: ok\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored; (\d+) measured; (\d+) filtered out", text)
        assert len(summaries) == 7, summaries
        assert sum(int(row[0]) for row in summaries) == 221, summaries
        assert all(row[1:] == ("0", "0", "0", "0") for row in summaries), summaries
        artifacts = []
        for line in text.splitlines():
            try:
                item = json.loads(line)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                continue
            if item.get("reason") == "compiler-artifact" and item.get("executable") and item.get("target", {}).get("kind") in (["test"], ["lib"]):
                artifacts.append(item)
        assert len(artifacts) == 7, [(item["target"]["name"], item["target"]["src_path"]) for item in artifacts]
        assert all(item["target"]["src_path"].startswith(str(WORKTREE) + "/") and not item["fresh"] for item in artifacts), artifacts
        for item in artifacts:
            executable = Path(item["executable"])
            item["verified_sha256"] = sha256(executable)
            item["verified_bytes"] = executable.stat().st_size
        (ARTIFACTS / "compiler-source-elf-proof.json").write_text(json.dumps({"test_total": 221, "summaries": summaries, "artifacts": artifacts, "source_bindings": len(baseline["hashes"]), "whole_source_git_index_status_unchanged": True}, indent=2) + "\n")
        selected = next(item for item in artifacts if item["target"]["name"] == "module_presentation")
        frozen_directory = Path("/tmp/module-presentation-verified-binaries")
        frozen_directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        frozen = frozen_directory / "module-presentation-tests20"
        assert not frozen.exists()
        original = Path(selected["executable"])
        try:
            os.link(original, frozen)
        except OSError:
            import shutil
            shutil.copy2(original, frozen)
        assert sha256(frozen) == selected["verified_sha256"] == sha256(original)
        (ARTIFACTS / "frozen-policy-executable.json").write_text(json.dumps({"source_artifact": selected, "frozen_executable": str(frozen), "sha256": sha256(frozen), "bytes": frozen.stat().st_size}, indent=2) + "\n")
(ARTIFACTS / "whole-product-source-after.json").write_text(json.dumps(snapshot(), indent=2) + "\n")
(ARTIFACTS / "actual-checks-summary.json").write_text(json.dumps({"checks": results, "supplemental_test_total": 20, "all_features_test_total": 221, "whole_source_bindings": len(baseline["hashes"]), "whole_source_git_index_status_unchanged": snapshot() == baseline, "five_original_tree_tests": "unported/not_run", "new_parity_credit": 0, "full_app_live_ci": "pending lead integration"}, indent=2) + "\n")

import hashlib, json, os, time
from pathlib import Path

ARTIFACTS = Path("/workspace/android-studio-artifacts/module-presentation-task")
record = json.loads((ARTIFACTS / "frozen-policy-executable.json").read_text())
executable = Path(record["frozen_executable"])
sha256 = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert sha256(executable) == record["sha256"]
log = ARTIFACTS / "long-name-exact-per-pid.log"
command = [str(executable), "--exact", "long_captured_names_are_borrowed_without_reformatting", "--nocapture", "--test-threads=1"]
with log.open("wb") as output:
    started = time.monotonic()
    process_id = os.posix_spawn(str(executable), command, os.environ.copy(), file_actions=[(os.POSIX_SPAWN_DUP2, output.fileno(), 1), (os.POSIX_SPAWN_DUP2, output.fileno(), 2)])
    waited_id, wait_status, usage = os.wait4(process_id, 0)
    elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
assert waited_id == process_id
exit_code = os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(wait_status)
assert exit_code == 0
assert "test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 19 filtered out" in log.read_text()
assert sha256(executable) == record["sha256"]
summary = {"command": command, "pid": process_id, "exit_code": exit_code, "elapsed_seconds": elapsed, "maximum_resident_kib": usage.ru_maxrss, "user_cpu_seconds": usage.ru_utime, "system_cpu_seconds": usage.ru_stime, "sha256_before_after": record["sha256"], "source_commit": json.loads((ARTIFACTS / "source-commit.json").read_text())["source_commit"], "source_sha256": "0a467aa8d96cb64dc93b23dd31526c75e4b5e2b4f8aad0c52c89025a2660208c", "test_input_imported_name_bytes": 10 * 32768, "test_input_external_id_bytes": 10 * 32768 + len(":application"), "runner_sha256": sha256(Path(__file__)), "log_sha256": sha256(log), "measurement_scope": "one actual existing supplemental test process, including startup/allocation/assertions/output; metadata borrowing coverage, not an adversarial colon-scan, allocation-count, memory-ceiling, full-IDE startup or large-project benchmark"}
(ARTIFACTS / "long-name-exact-per-pid.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(summary))
